title: Smart Batch/Cache Suggestion Orchestrator with Staged Apply and Signal-driven Rollback
creator: Marco Chen
description: Build an orchestrator service that converts offline batching/caching recommendations into staged, observable configuration changes with automated safety gates. The orchestrator should: 1) score candidate suggestions by estimated token-savings and predicted quality delta, 2) synthesize a staged apply plan (shadow -> canary -> progressive traffic percentages), 3) run a tailored eval suite including tenant-specific golden prompts and diversity cohorts, and 4) automatically trigger rollbacks when signal-driven detectors cross risk thresholds. This work bridges the cost-tuning advisor output with runtime-safe apply and captures telemetry for post-mortems.
motivation: Optimization recommendations today are manual and either underutilized or rolled out too aggressively. We need an automated, auditable path to capture cost wins while preventing customer-visible quality regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator ingests recommendation artifacts from the advisor (JSON manifest) and produces a deterministic staged apply plan
Shadow apply mode is implemented: candidate config is exercised on a mirrored subset of traffic with zero user exposure and generated outputs logged
Eval suite runs automatically during staged rollout and computes per-cohort quality metrics and a single composite quality delta metric
Automatic rollback triggers when composite quality delta exceeds configurable per-tenant thresholds or when golden-prompt failure rate increases beyond the threshold
Instrumentation surfaces token-savings estimate, observed savings, and quality deltas in Console; at minimum per-model and per-tenant views
End-to-end tests and a canary run on internal tenant produce expected rollback for a synthetic degrading change
Runbook and Confluence doc updated with step-by-step operator recovery and SLA impact estimation
design_notes: Quality signal composition: blend of n-gram overlap metrics, embedding cosine drift on responses, per-prompt BLEU-like metric for structured outputs, and a human-review sample bucket for adjudication
Golden prompt selection: pick 50 prompts per tenant using stratified sampling (high-frequency, edge-case, and business-critical intents); allow PR-driven overrides for product owners
Staged rollout: shadow -> 1% canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with configurable time windows and optional manual hold

Rollback policy: circuit-breaker with 'soft' and 'hard' thresholds. Soft threshold pauses rollout and escalates to human reviewer. Hard threshold auto-reverts within the orchestrator and emits incident alerts
Safety margin calculator: translate predicted quality delta to minimum acceptable token-savings using cost-utility curve so tiny savings cannot cause large quality regressions
Telemetry: correlate request IDs between shadow runs and primary runs to compute token delta and output-difference metrics in Console
tests: Unit: suggestion manifest parsing, scoring logic, and rollout state machine
Integration: end-to-end with advisor mock, runtime shadow endpoint, eval harness, and Console metrics ingestion
E2E: synthetic degrading model variant to ensure automatic rollback triggers and confirm canary isolation
Fuzz: random suggestion parameterization to validate no crash loops and proper reversion behavior
metrics: Median latency change on affected routes
Number of manual interventions per month
rollout_plan: Stage 0: Internal dev shadow runs for 48h against internal tenant
Stage 1: Canary 1% with active eval suite for 24-72h; require soft-threshold pass
Stage 2: 10% for 48h; require no hard-threshold violations and less than 0.5% regression on golden prompts
Stage 3: 50% for 24h then 100% if steady; auto-rollback on hard threshold breach
Operator steps documented and automated escalation to SRE and PM when soft-threshold is hit
dashboard_and_alerts: Console: new Cost-Safety panel showing staged apply status, token-savings projections, and live quality delta
Alert: 'Cost-Safety: hard rollback' -> PagerDuty; include recent golden-prompt diffs and sample responses
Alert: 'Cost-Safety: soft pause' -> Slack channel #cost-tuning and an automated summary to the owner
updates: 2026-02-26: Kickoff meeting with Advisor and Runtime owners. Agreed to accept advisor JSON manifest v2. Noted requirement to maintain request ID mapping for shadow runs.
2026-03-03: Implemented initial manifest parser and scoring prototype. Early scoring heuristic uses token-savings * (1 - predicted_quality_loss).
2026-03-07: Eval harness added tenant stratification and golden prompt generator. PM requested ability to pin custom golden prompt sets per tenant.
2026-03-11: Integration tests failing in 10% staging due to missing KV cache warmup in shadow mode; fixed by adding explicit KV prefetch in orchestrator shadow runner.

2026-03-13: First internal canary completed; composite quality delta 0.12% improvement while observing 18% token reduction on test routes. Logged next steps to harden rollback cadence and update runbook.
